note: Operator-facing labels in Noor's languages (sw = demo language, en = fallback). Visitor-facing text lives in replies.json.

availability.en: Asking if you are open / have space
availability.sw: Anauliza kama mko wazi / kuna nafasi

dietary_accessibility.en: Asking about food needs or accessibility
dietary_accessibility.sw: Anauliza kuhusu chakula maalum au ufikiaji

cancel_change.en: Wants to cancel or change a booking

ask_a_person.en: Not sure what the visitor wants (confidence {pct}%). Please read the message and reply yourself, or send the holding reply.
ask_a_person.sw: Sina uhakika mgeni anataka nini (uhakika {pct}%). Tafadhali soma ujumbe na ujibu mwenyewe, au tuma jibu la kusubiri.

unsupported_language.en: The message is in a language this tool does not support. You can send the 'please write in English, French or Kiswahili' reply, or ask the guide.
unsupported_language.sw: Ujumbe uko katika lugha ambayo chombo hiki hakitumii. Unaweza kutuma jibu la 'tafadhali andika kwa Kiingereza, Kifaransa au Kiswahili', au muulize mwongozaji.

new_enquiry.sw: KARIBU: Ujumbe mpya kutoka {contact} ({language}). {intent_label}. "{excerpt}" Jibu 1 = tuma jibu la kawaida, 2 = tuma 'nitajibu baadaye', au andika jibu lako.
new_enquiry.en: KARIBU: New message from {contact} ({language}). {intent_label}. "{excerpt}" Reply 1 = send standard reply, 2 = send holding reply, or type your own reply.

unsure_enquiry.sw: KARIBU: Ujumbe mpya kutoka {contact} ({language}). Sina uhakika anataka nini ({pct}%). "{excerpt}" Jibu 2 = tuma 'nitajibu baadaye', au andika jibu lako.
unsure_enquiry.en: KARIBU: New message from {contact} ({language}). Not sure what they want ({pct}%). "{excerpt}" Reply 2 = send holding reply, or type your own reply.

nothing_pending.en: KARIBU: No message is waiting for a reply.
